name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Iran attacks on Gulf states; US blockade on
summary: Trump says Iran fired more drones and missiles in the week to 23 Nov than at any point in the war; Qatar mediates
state: Trump said on 23 Nov that Iran had fired more drones and missiles in the past week than at any point since the war began, all intercepted, and that strikes could resume in 2027 if talks fail; Iran hit an industrial site in Bahrain on 21 Nov (Bloomberg via Rigzone). Iran targeted US sites at Bahrain's Isa Air Base on 17 Nov and Kuwait's Ali Al-Salem on 18 Nov, an ADNOC vessel was attacked in Hormuz on 17 Nov, and US jets struck an IRGC launch site on Qeshm (Gulf News). Hormuz transits fell by more than 40% in the week to 23 Nov amid Iranian tanker attacks (Al Jazeera), and Qatar is mediating. Active strikes between states keep the Alert.
for_you: People in or travelling to the Gulf should follow FCDO travel advice and local civil defence instructions; airlines have cancelled some regional routes into late November. Energy and shipping costs tend to rise while attacks continue.
rubric_hit: Alert: active strikes between states and attacks on Gulf shipping (Bahrain 21 Nov; Iranian salvos week to 23 Nov)

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
